_provenance: Managed Sleeves P1: schema-derived with runtime validator. Column set authored from feature-plans/managed-sleeves.md §Architecture 'DB (additive migrations)' and the sleeve-db/sleeve-integration-impl/sleeve-risk-impl interface-agreement thread, cross-checked against migrations/033_sleeves.sql. No producer-computed values are captured; all assertions are shape/presence/constraint checks.
description: Expected schema shape for the five Managed Sleeves P1 tables after migration 033_sleeves.sql is applied.

sleeves._note: status is TEXT with no CHECK constraint (matches codebase convention -- enum enforcement is app-level, not DB-level). name has a UNIQUE index (idx_sleeves_name), not a PK.

sleeve_rules._note: Schema-ready for the P2 rule engine. sleeve_id is a soft FK to sleeves.id (no PRAGMA foreign_keys in this codebase). Not written or read by any P1 code path.

status_values_app_level._note: No separate SUBMITTED/OPEN/PARTIALLY_FILLED synonyms invented for post-ack states -- Alpaca already names those; only the pre-ack window (before any alpaca_order_id exists) needed a new sleeve-side value.

sleeve_orders._note: client_order_id is the durable correlation key, minted BEFORE the broker call so a row exists at reserve-time for crash-safe recovery (subprocess-per-minute engine, no in-memory-only state). alpaca_order_id is nullable and populated only once the broker acks. rule_id is nullable -- P1 has no rules yet, so every P1 order carries rule_id=NULL. qty is REAL (fractional shares). reserved_price is the estimate used to size the cash reservation at insert time -- distinct from the actual fill price in sleeve_fills. Sell orders (long-only, reduce-only) reserve SHARES not cash, so reserved_price is NULL for sells.
unique_indexes: idx_sleeve_orders_alpaca_order_id (alpaca_order_id) WHERE alpaca_order_id IS NOT NULL
non_unique_indexes: idx_sleeve_orders_rule_id (rule_id) WHERE rule_id IS NOT NULL

sleeve_fills._note: order_id is a soft FK to sleeve_orders.id (the internal id, not alpaca_order_id/client_order_id). broker_fill_id is the Alpaca Account Activities (activity_type=FILL) `id` -- one row per discrete fill event including partials; nullable, UNIQUE when present, for dedup across overlapping reconciliation poll windows. filled_at is the broker-reported fill timestamp; created_at is row-insert time. Multiple fills per order are expected (partial fills) -- no uniqueness constraint on order_id.
unique_indexes: idx_sleeve_fills_broker_fill_id (broker_fill_id) WHERE broker_fill_id IS NOT NULL

sleeve_runtime._note: Composite PK (rule_id, key) -- no surrogate id column. Pure key/value runtime store, upserted via INSERT OR REPLACE (port_state precedent, migration 010). Schema-ready for the P2 rule engine's pacing/latch/bench state; not written or read by any P1 code path.

no_foreign_key_pragma: PRAGMA foreign_keys is never set ON anywhere in this codebase (verified). All *_id references above are soft FKs: documented, not DB-enforced.
